notes.title: Update build 0.22.05011
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest open from 05/01 till 10/01[/h1]

New feature added : Damage multiplier. Dodge closer to enemies to increase your damages

Re-balancing of all weapons and their attacks
Re-balancing of enemies and progression of the run
Re-balancing of some upgrades

Added tutorial on beginning of runs to help new players
Correction of a bug avoiding elites to spawn
Improved visibility with new cursor requested during first playtest and observed on live playtest
Rework of the main menu

notes.title: Update build 0.16.21121
notes.content:
Added a quick in game tutorial for controls (keyboard/mouse/game-pad)
Correction of a glitch on enemy spawning area

notes.title: Update build 0.15.19121
notes.content:
Improved animation on enemy death
Added small reward on elite death (more exp)
EXP now roll on floor when enemy die
Smoother transition between enemy levels
Small fix on animation not happening at good time (or not at all)
